prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game skill icon, square, designed to remain crisp and immediately legible at 48x48 pixels in a compact action-game HUD. Primary request: Frost-Ring Inversion for Gu Pin, an original salvage-world signal technician. Single bold focal object: an industrial annular signal receiver tilted slightly in three-quarter perspective, an aged ivory ceramic ring with a warm copper rim and dark umber underside. Its center remains visibly open. Around its outer edge one compact expanding icy ring consists of six broad short wedge-shaped pale cyan mineral ice crystals, sharp outward points. Frost inversion is conveyed by this single clear icy circular silhouette, with restrained peacock-teal energy linking the facets. Keep the ring apparatus visible and tactile, not a magic rune or snowflake glyph. Premium hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy illustration, chunky readable planes, high local contrast, controlled highlights, crafted original machinery. Palette: aged ivory #D2D1BB, peacock teal #3E8D8D, pale cool cyan frost, dark umber #4B443D, restrained warm copper. Centered, full ring and short crystal points contained inside generous 12% safe margins. Sparse composition with one dominant ring, no fine little particles, no busy circuitry. Transparent alpha background, completely isolated. No environment, ground, background color, ground shadow, border, frame, circular UI badge, text, numbers, letters, logos or watermark. No character, no magical runes, no ornate filigree, no recognizable existing game symbol. Do not add a square panel behind the icon.
